title: ZogsMods
description: A collection of client-side performance, optimisation and aesthetic tweaks for a better vanilla experience.
body:
Zogs Mods is a modpack that aims to provide an overhauled Minecraft experience without any serverside mods. This modpack can be used on any server without any conflict.

## Included Mods
### Performance
The staple performance mods are included such as Sodium, Starlight, FerriteCore, etc.

### Optimisation
Debugify, Carpet Fixes and more are included to fix minor bugs in worlds. This does not affect the server compatibility.

### Functionality
Multiple mods are included to enhance functionality in-game, like Mouse Wheelie, Detail Armor Bar and more.

### Aesthetics
Subtle aesthetic mods have been added like Clear Skies and Falling Leaves. A few resourcepacks and shaders are also included, like Even Better Enchants, Complementary Reimagined and Rethinking Voxels.

### Multiplayer
For servers that support it, Voice Chat and View Distance Fix is included in this modpack, and Bobby is also added for aeshetic purposes.

## Optional Mods
There are a few mods that have been disabled by default because they are slightly outside the scope of this modpack, but can be enabled easily.
- **Better Clouds:** This mod replaces the vanilla clouds with interesting animated square clusters. It's highly configurable and performant, remaining in-line with vanilla guidelines while still being unique. It is disabled because it is a big change to aesthetics, but if you want to use it, simply enable it.
- **Fresh Animations:** This resourcepack overhauls all mobs with new animations that are more in-line with the new animation style in 1.19-1.21. It is a major aesthetic rework, so is disabled by default, but can be enabled and activated in-game, and should work perfectly.

**_DO NOT ENABLE LAMBDABETTERGRASS, IT IS OUTDATED FOR NOW. THE MODPACK WILL BE UPDATED WHEN IT IS._**
